The wildcard is expanded against the vendored src directory, existence is checked by exact readdir name, and a missing mapped source file throws.

peerChange.codeChange: role-model-router/packages/foldkit/build.mjs now rewrites the vendored `@effect/platform-browser` specifier to `@role-model-router/effect-platform-browser` (esbuild onResolve, external) and lists the workspace specifier in `external` instead of the bare vendored one. Disclosed deviation: build.mjs was not in the task's writable list ('package.json (peer specifier only) and its graph-closure test'); the change is required for the repoint to be real and is reversible.
